description.en: Chestnut horse portrait with an ivory blaze and one colorful bird.
description.zh: 栗棕色骏马头像、象牙白额纹与一只多彩小鸟。

description.en: Three unequal wind folds lean into a canter, with long curves and offset seams suggesting forward movement.
description.zh: 三道长短不同的折线顺风倾斜，以错落的接缝呼应骏马轻快向前的姿态。

transform.method: Uniformly fit complete motif linework into 432px, leaving a transparent 40px tile perimeter. No clipped paths or recolored project artwork.

hero.method: Authored canvas composition of the complete archived foreground and project-specific supporting texture; no new image-model call, no crop or recolor

sourceScope: Hexly-only collection. Existing product source/adoption metadata stays unchanged; new kit adoption is separate.

appliesTo: hexly.ai project introduction and brand archive
Hexly-authored promotional video, deck, social and campaign material
scope.officialProjectIdentity: Preserve original shape, proportions, colors and bytes. No terracotta recoloring.
scope.productUI: Independent product palettes, themes and UI are outside this scope; this release neither changes nor prescribes them.
scope.campaignInterpretation: Existing family artwork or any future GPT Image campaign Hero is a Hexly interpretation, not an official project-logo replacement. Record its independent origin and adoption state.
scope.localAccent: A small accent may quote an evidenced logo color on a Hexly surface without modifying the logo.

campaignInterpretation.description: The archived Hexly family artwork, reused without recoloring or redrawing. Hero and theme texture are Hexly-only promotional compositions.
